/calls.reason: Session-bound dial and list workflow; the seat it reserves belongs to auth.uid() and means nothing to another caller

/calls/end.reason: Session-bound: only the seller who owns the call, or a tenant admin, may release its dial attempt

/calls/{id}/recording.reason: Session-bound playback policy and short-lived redirect; not API-key compatible

/contract-templates/extract-text.reason: Session-only authoring helper that reads an uploaded document into the template form and stores nothing

/imports/file.reason: Browser multipart import flow redirects into the tenant UI and uses session-bound RLS

/integrations/parsehub/webhook.reason: Provider callback authenticated by project secret

/telephony/numbers/available.reason: Admin-only search against the platform's own provider account; it exposes which account Kundexa runs on and what numbers cost, and the next button after it sends an invoice

/telephony/status.reason: Current-user readiness projection depends on auth.uid() and the tenant this session is acting in

/telephony/webphone/heartbeat.reason: Liveness for the signed-in seller's own webphone registration; the session is resolved from auth.uid() and means nothing to another caller

/telephony/webphone/leg.reason: The signed-in seller's own browser reporting its call leg; it is never authoritative and means nothing from another caller

/telephony/webphone/session.reason: Mints short-lived webphone credentials for the signed-in seller's own browser; publishing it would invite callers to request credentials they cannot use

/calls/dialing.reason: Browser reports the provider call id for the seat it already holds
